falsifiable_hypothesis: The verified paid-extrema/cardinality calibrator shows a strong shared sample-level signal from the already purchased 64 B wells. The remaining target-local residual is likely different for two-dose versus three-dose heads because their local paid summaries have different sampling geometry. Fit the two cardinalities separately, but regularize them toward a shared local residual model by exactly one inner-fold equivalent 1/K with K=3.
base_prediction_rule: Start from the verified two_dose_full_negative_A_extension predictions. Do not stack any previous paid-calibration prediction into the candidate.
global_feature_rule: For each held inner fold recompute the deterministic 64-well plan from the other two authenticated whole-patient inner folds and acquire B. Fit a patient-balanced affine common residual model on global mean, population standard deviation, minimum and maximum.
cardinality_contrast_rule: Fit the two-dose minus three-dose mean residual contrast using only global minimum and maximum. Apply the exact equal-target half-pooling algebra: two-dose heads receive common+d/3, three-dose heads common-d/6.
local_target_rule: Cross-fit the upstream global/cardinality correction across K=3 inner folds. Subtract each held-fold pooled correction from the selected bandwidth-0.7 B residual to form leakage-resistant local residual targets. From each target's already-purchased wells compute local mean, population standard deviation, minimum and maximum. Also retain the deterministic two-dose/three-dose indicator for the shared local model.
local_model_rule: Fit three patient-balanced residual models: (1) one shared 5-feature model over all 24 targets using local mean/std/min/max plus the cardinality indicator, (2) one four-feature model on two-dose target rows only, and (3) one four-feature model on three-dose target rows only. All sample-target weights are normalized after group masking.
pooling_rule: For each target, let D_sep be its cardinality-specific four-feature local prediction and D_common the shared five-feature local prediction. With fixed K=3 deploy D_pool=(K-1)/K*D_sep + 1/K*D_common = 2/3*D_sep+1/3*D_common. This is the only pooling weight and is fixed by the authenticated inner-fold count.
local_strength_rule: Add exactly 2*PRIOR=0.25 times D_pool, with PRIOR=0.125 inherited from the frozen upstream lineage. No local-strength menu exists.
prediction_rule: Orientation A is copied unchanged from two_dose_full_negative_A_extension. Orientation B equals that base B prediction plus the pooled global/cardinality correction plus 0.25*D_pool. No extra wells are added and the physical 32/32 plate plan remains unchanged.
verification_rule: Recompute every fitting-only calibration and paid feature from frozen inputs. Because pseudoinverse and dot-product replay can differ by one floating-point ulp across BLAS execution, prediction replay passes only if maximum absolute difference is <=5e-16 and MSE difference <=1e-15; report the actual maximum rather than claiming bitwise identity.

task_contract.ab_rule: average losses across separately costed A/B orientations; never average predictions
